_ordering_rationale: Ordre PV décroissante. Humira (LOE), Skyrizi+Rinvoq (relais immuno), Aesthetics (Botox/Juvederm), Neuroscience.

kpis.signal: Patent cliff biosimilaires US 2023, érosion -37.6% FY24 vs FY23
kpis.description_fr: Anti-TNF #1 historique. LOE biosimilaires US démarrée janvier 2023. Érosion accélérée FY24. Pilier déclinant.
kpis.description_en: Top historical anti-TNF. US biosimilars LOE started January 2023. Accelerated FY24 erosion. Declining pillar.

kpis.signal: Relais Humira #1, +51% FY24, psoriasis + IBD, atteint blockbuster ARR 11.7Mds$
kpis.description_fr: IL-23 immunologie. Indication psoriasis, arthrite psoriasique, Crohn, colite ulcéreuse. Premier relais Humira, croissance >50%/an.
kpis.description_en: IL-23 immunology. Psoriasis, psoriatic arthritis, Crohn's, ulcerative colitis. Top Humira relay, >50%/yr growth.

kpis.signal: JAK inhibitor multi-indication, +51% FY24, second relais Humira
kpis.description_fr: JAK1 inhibitor oral. Polyarthrite rhumatoïde, arthrite psoriasique, dermatite atopique, spondylarthrite, Crohn, colite ulcéreuse. Combo avec Skyrizi = relais immuno post-Humira.
kpis.description_en: Oral JAK1 inhibitor. RA, psoriatic arthritis, atopic dermatitis, axial spondyloarthritis, Crohn's, UC. Combo with Skyrizi = post-Humira immunology relay.

kpis.signal: Acquis via Allergan 2020, recul FY24 (Chine + macro), franchise cash + marge
kpis.description_fr: Botox Cosmetic + Juvederm fillers + autres (CoolSculpting). Issu acquisition Allergan 63 Mds$ (2020). Pression Chine + sensible macro.
kpis.description_en: Botox Cosmetic + Juvederm fillers + others (CoolSculpting). From $63B Allergan acquisition (2020). China pressure + macro-sensitive.

kpis.signal: Vraylar + Botox therapeutic + Ubrelvy + Qulipta, +15.5% FY24, diversification
kpis.description_fr: Portefeuille Vraylar (schizophrénie/bipolaire), Botox therapeutic (migraine), Ubrelvy/Qulipta (CGRP migraine). Croissance solide.
kpis.description_en: Vraylar (schizophrenia/bipolar), Botox therapeutic (migraine), Ubrelvy/Qulipta (CGRP migraine) portfolio. Solid growth.

kpis.signal: Imbruvica déclin compensé par Venclexta + Elahere (ImmunoGen 2023)
kpis.description_fr: Imbruvica (LLC, en érosion), Venclexta (CLL/AML), Elahere (cancer ovaires post-ImmunoGen 10 Mds$). Pipeline ADC.
kpis.description_en: Imbruvica (CLL, eroding), Venclexta (CLL/AML), Elahere (ovarian cancer post-$10B ImmunoGen). ADC pipeline.
